rows.behavior: aim is gone: aim.toml and aim.lock.toml are deleted, AGENTS.md has no aim: marker or aim header, and CLAUDE.md is still a symlink to AGENTS.md.
rows.fails_when: either aim file exists, AGENTS.md contains 'aim:' or names agent-integrations-manager, or CLAUDE.md is not a symlink resolving to AGENTS.md
rows.command: uv run --directory cli pytest tests/test_agent_tooling.py -q -k aim_is_gone

rows.behavior: apm.yml declares the 12 skills (the 10 from jasperhg90/skills, adhd and bencium-impact-designer), the 6 jasperhg90/skills rules and the 2 subagents, each pinned to a commit or tag.
rows.fails_when: any of the 12 skills, 6 rules or 2 subagents is missing from apm.yml, or a dependency has no ref
rows.command: uv run --directory cli pytest tests/test_agent_tooling.py -q -k apm_declares_the_tooling

rows.behavior: The drawio and excalidraw MCP servers are dropped from apm.yml and .mcp.json.
rows.fails_when: apm.yml or .mcp.json names drawio or excalidraw
rows.command: uv run --directory cli pytest tests/test_agent_tooling.py -q -k mcp_servers_are_dropped

rows.behavior: slop-scan-for-docs is committed under .claude/rules, byte-identical to aim's pin, and .gitignore lets it through.
rows.fails_when: the file's sha256 is not ccce6d06e1707ea75cc0c25a3a06f163b4faa778b4d9b6d9833681cabd74c486, or git check-ignore reports it ignored
rows.command: uv run --directory cli pytest tests/test_agent_tooling.py -q -k slop_scan_is_vendored

rows.behavior: OpenCode gets the 7 rules in .opencode/rules, each byte-identical to its .claude/rules copy, and no adversarial-reviewer or feature-planner in .opencode/agents; both install recipes do this by naming the 7 rules, not by a glob.
rows.fails_when: a rule is missing from .opencode/rules or differs from .claude/rules, a rule outside the 7 is copied, either subagent file is in .opencode/agents, or kmctl-install and kmctl-install-frozen do not both copy and remove
rows.command: uv run --directory cli pytest tests/test_agent_tooling.py -q -k opencode

rows.behavior: The pre-commit exclude covers every path APM or kmctl plugin patch writes: .agents/, .opencode/, opencode.json, .mcp.json and apm.lock.yaml, besides .claude/ and .loop/.
rows.fails_when: the top-level exclude regex of .pre-commit-config.yaml does not match a file under each of those paths
rows.command: uv run --directory cli pytest tests/test_agent_tooling.py -q -k installer_owns_its_files

rows.behavior: README.md documents the manual caveman install (claude plugin marketplace add juliusbrussee/caveman, then claude plugin install caveman@caveman) and names the justfile's real recipes kmctl-install, kmctl-init and kmctl-check.
rows.fails_when: README.md lacks either caveman command, or names just install, just init or just check as recipes
rows.command: uv run --directory cli pytest tests/test_agent_tooling.py -q -k readme

rows.behavior: just check-install passes on a clean checkout of the change.
rows.fails_when: on a fresh git repo holding every tracked and unignored file of the worktree, committed, just check-install exits nonzero or leaves git status non-empty
rows.command: tmp=$(mktemp -d) && git ls-files -co --exclude-standard -z | tar --null -cf - -T - | tar -xf - -C "$tmp" && cd "$tmp" && git init -q && git add -A && git -c user.email=eval@local -c user.name=eval commit -qm eval && just check-install

rows.behavior: Each installed skill file is byte-identical to aim's copy from the step 1 snapshot, and the diff of rules and subagents against that snapshot is recorded for the operator.
rows.fails_when: diff -r between the snapshot and .claude/skills is not empty for the 12 skills, or no rule and subagent diff is reported

rows.behavior: A decision record says the guidelines stay in AGENTS.md, not in a rule, and names moving them into a rule as the rejected option.
rows.fails_when: no new .okf/decisions record covers it, or it does not name the rejected option
